pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-09.png again with Read and looked at it. It is a new export: the image hash differs from the earlier page 09 requests, and the layout has visibly changed. The figures are grey placeholder boxes with name labels. The page has five panels. Panel A, top left: a wide caption 'Welbuk Practice sends Ravi's follow-up reminder on WhatsApp. No calls from the front desk.' Below it is a teal label 'FOLLOW-UP REMINDER', with a smaller 'ravi' to its right. Panel B, top right: caption 'On the day, Ravi arrives empty-handed. No files to find, no reports to re-enter: Welbuk already has them.' with a very small 'ravi'. Panel C, middle left: caption 'He checks in himself. No queue at the desk.' with 'ravi' at centre and a small 'meera' lower left. Panel D, middle right: caption 'As usual, his slot comes up on the screen.' and a teal label 'NOW · A-31' at right, with 'ravi' below left. Panel E, full-width bottom tier: 'ananya' at left, then the balloon 'Welcome back, Ravi. Your results are already here.' with a tiny tail at its lower-left corner pointing to ananya, then 'ravi' at right. Ravi reacts silently without replying. A caption at the bottom reads 'Fewer missed follow-ups, shorter visits, less paperwork. The clinic's time goes to patients.' Reading order: A caption, FOLLOW-UP REMINDER label, B caption, C caption, D caption, NOW · A-31 label, Ananya's balloon, bottom caption.
pages.observation: The order is clear: a two-by-two grid read left to right and top to bottom, then the bottom tier. In Panel E the balloon now sits between Ananya and Ravi, slightly closer to Ravi: its right edge is around x 681 and the ravi box starts near x 704. Its tail is a very small wedge at the lower-left corner, pressed against the end of the 'ananya' name label. With the tail this small, a reader could take 'Welcome back, Ravi' as spoken by the figure on the right, which would be wrong, since Ravi cannot greet himself. The tail needs to be longer and clearer, or the balloon should move toward Ananya. Ravi does not answer, so his reaction has to come from the art. Panel E has a large empty middle between the figures and the bottom caption. The bottom caption's lower edge nearly touches the bottom panel border. In Panel A the caption now spans almost the full panel width and sits flush with the top and right borders. The placeholders in Panels B and C are tiny. Meera's role in Panel C is unexplained, which sits oddly with 'No queue at the desk'. 'On the day' carries the time skip, and 'As usual' depends on remembering page 04's slot screen. All text is readable and none overflows its box.
